fixes.explanation: True, baker, because verse 21 says "…those who love it will eat its fruit." That ties right back to verse 20, with the same crop picture. Love the tongue, and you eat what it grows, so plant carefully.

Yes, baker, the verse puts both in one line: "He who finds a wife finds a good thing and obtains favor from the LORD." The extra blessing is favor from the LORD. That makes two blessings in one verse.

Yes, baker, the verse says "A man of many companions may come to ruin, but there is a friend who stays closer than a brother." It puts one true friend up against a whole crowd. I'd take that one friend.
